grading_system.evidence: Our standards-based grading language and scale is comparable to the 4.0 scale which is used in many schools and colleges.
grading_system.proficiency_scale: 1.0-4.0 (standards-based performance descriptors; 4.0 = exceeded standard, 3.0 = met standard, 2.0 = progressing, 1.0 = beginning; Inc. = no evidence)

schedule.evidence: Each quarter and semester, a course grade is reported on report cards. It is important to note that a semester grade is a grade for the entire semester.

credit_definition.text: Courses are listed as full year (1.0 credit) or semester (0.5 credit), e.g. 'Driver Education ... Semester, 0.5 Credit'; flexible pathway courses carry .5 or 1 elective credit.

course_load.min_courses_or_credits: minimum 5 credits per year (students below 5 are not full-time)
course_load.evidence: All students in grades 9-12 must carry a minimum of 5 credits per year. Students who take fewer than 5 credits will not be considered full-time.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Catalog states requirements directly in credits; no conversion needed. Required: English/Language Arts 4, social studies 3, math 3 (Algebra I, Geometry, Algebra II, Precalculus, AP Calculus pathways), science 3, world language 2, PE 1.5, fine arts 1, senior capstone 0.5, electives 4. Advancement: 5 credits to grade 10, 11 to grade 11, 15 to grade 12, 22 to graduate.

cte_centers: Green Mountain Technical and Career Center (GMTCC)
notes: Diploma requires 22 credits (p.3). Grading is standards-based (1.0-4.0 performance levels, p.5-6); transferable skills (timeliness and preparedness, self-awareness and responsibility) are assessed and factored into course grades (p.5). The catalog does not explicitly say proficiency is a condition of graduation, so hybrid is recorded on that basis. Credit-passing threshold is not stated. Senior Capstone (0.5 credit, required) has no course entry in the catalog. Work-Based Learning requires permission of instructor and Leadership class (p.21). Dual enrollment: two college courses tuition-free, principal approval required (p.22). Schedule structure (blocks, periods) is not described in the catalog. Catalog is the 2026-27 Google Doc export (24 pages), updated August 2026.
